name: Germanic Languages and Literatures
about: The Department of Germanic Languages and Literatures offers a major that introduces students to the literatures, cultures, and intellectual traditions of the German-speaking world from the Middle Ages to the present. The program develops advanced competence in the German language and provides training in the analysis and interpretation of literary and cultural texts. Students engage with major works of German literature, philosophy, film, and critical theory, and explore the historical and cultural contexts in which they were produced. The major encourages interdisciplinary perspectives and prepares students for careers in education, international affairs, translation, and graduate study in the humanities.
